resources.string: Isilawuli esintantayo se-Private Audio. Isimo: %1$s. Izilawuli zokuvula/ukucisha, ukunweba nokuvala.

I-Private Audio ayidingi i-akhawunti noma ukungena ngemvume futhi ayiceli imvume yemakrofoni. Ayithwebuli noma irekhode umsindo wemakrofoni, futhi ayirekhodi noma igcine izingxoxo zakho noma okuqukethwe kwazo komsindo.

I-Private Audio isebenzisa ulwazi lwesistimu yomsindo ye-Android oludingekayo ekuqondiseni nasekuhloleni. Ukuhlola kungabheka isimo sobuchwepheshe nemethadatha evezwa ama-API asesidlangalaleni e-Android, kuhlanganise nemethadatha yokudlala neyeseshini yokuqopha. Imethadatha yeseshini yokuqopha iwulwazi lobuchwepheshe lwesistimu yomsindo; i-Private Audio ayithwebuli umsindo wemakrofoni ohlobene nalezo seshini. Ulwazi lokuhlola lungahlanganisa izinhlobo zohlelo ne-Android, ulwazi lwedivayisi nemodeli, inqubo nesimo sohlelo, amadivayisi omsindo atholakalayo nawamanje, imethadatha esesidlangalaleni yokumiswa kokudlala nokuqopha, kanye nemizamo yokuqondisa, imiphumela, izikhathi nezehlakalo zobuchwepheshe.

Izintandokazi zohlelo zigcinwa endaweni kusitoreji esiyimfihlo sohlelo lwe-Private Audio. Ulwazi lokuhlola lwenziwa futhi lucutshungulwe kudivayisi yakho futhi lungaba sesimweni sendawo sohlelo olusebenzayo. Imibiko ayigcinwa noma ithunyelwe ngokuzenzakalela. Umbiko ohlala njalo wenziwa ngaphandle kwesitoreji esiyimfihlo se-Private Audio kuphela lapho ukhetha ngokusobala okuthi Londoloza umbiko wokuhlola bese ukhetha indawo nge-Android. Ngemva kokuthekelisa, indawo noma isevisi oyikhethile—hhayi i-Private Audio—ilawula ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa nokususwa kwaleyo khophi.

Inguqulo yamanje ayiceli imvume ye-Inthanethi ye-Android, ayinayo ingemuva leseva le-Private Audio noma indlela yokudlulisa ngenethiwekhi, futhi ayifaki amasevisi noma ama-SDK okuhlaziya, okukhangisa noma okubika ukuphahlazeka. Okwamanje ayithumeli imibiko yokuhlola kunjiniyela noma kuseva ye-Private Audio, ngakho i-Private Audio ayigcini ukuxilonga ohlangothini lweseva.

Idatha yohlelo ayifakwa kusipele samafu se-Android noma ekudlulisweni phakathi kwamadivayisi. Izintandokazi zendawo zihlala kusitoreji esiyimfihlo sohlelo zize zishintshwe noma kususwe idatha yohlelo; isimo sokuhlola sesikhashana asiwona umbiko ogciniwe. Imibiko ethekelisiwe ihlala ngaphansi kokulawulwa indawo noma isevisi oyikhethile.
Ukukhetha ulimi ngaphakathi kwe-app kudinga i-Android 13 noma inguqulo entsha. Le divayisi ilandela ulimi lwesistimu.
